selection_protocol.candidate_pool: The 20 frozen HE-EDIT-* tasks built by benchmarks/phase0/build_tasks.py from a pinned HumanEval commit; each passed the 12-check offline validator.
selection_protocol.difficulty_assignment: a priori static rubric over task-intrinsic features only (mutation category, indentation, nesting, anchor ambiguity, target size).
bias_controls: No observed model output influences task selection or ranking.
The historical 120-attempt run over the same tasks is excluded from selection by design.
Any pilot used for power analysis must draw from the held-out pool of non-selected HumanEval problems, not from these 20.

held_out_pool.description: HumanEval problems inspected but not selected into the final 20; available for an explicitly separated pilot.

mutation.description: Replace the comparison operator of a comparison expression with a different, logically adjacent operator (e.g. '>' becomes '>=').

feature_notes: mutation site is inside an indented block

tasks.expected_difficulty_mechanism: Semantic (not syntactic) defect: the repaired line differs from the defective line by one comparison operator, so a text patch that matches the wrong occurrence, or a full-file rewrite that drops the surrounding branch, can still be syntactically valid and still fail the hidden test. Indentation sensitivity: the defect and its repair sit inside an indented block, where a text edit that loses or adds a level of indentation produces a syntax error or a silently different control-flow boundary.
